CRM_ERP.name: every open deal sits in a real stage
open pipeline = the open deals added up
weighted pipeline = each deal × its stage odds
weighted pipeline is never more than the raw pipeline
stage totals add up to the whole pipeline
win rate = won ÷ (won + lost)
a lost deal is never counted in the pipeline
moving a deal on advances it exactly one stage
moving a deal on raises its weighted value
winning a deal takes it out of the open pipeline
winning a deal adds its value to the won total
a customer’s worth = their orders minus their returns
order count matches the order list
total customer worth = every order minus every return
average order value = worth ÷ number of orders
return rate is always between 0 and 100
nobody has a negative last-order age
repeat rate = customers who bought twice ÷ customers who bought
every customer lands in exactly one segment
segment counts add up to the number of customers
segment values add up to the total customer worth
a Champion has bought 4+ times and bought recently
an At-risk customer has not ordered in 90 days
a Sleeping customer has not ordered in 180 days
every segment has an offer written for it
a customer’s channel mix adds up to their gross
a customer’s channel mix adds up to their worth
a logged note appears on that customer
a logged note appears on nobody else
every capability this app uses is a known one
no capability offers only one choice
every capability works with nothing connected (built-in or by hand)
every capability has an option you can host yourself
exactly one provider is active per capability
the default provider never needs an outside service
no single company is unavoidable across capabilities
switching a provider changes which one is active
